name: blackroad-ai-agent-framework
description: Self-orchestrating AI agent framework with Cloudflare Workers - auto-healing, repo-syncing, cohesion-monitoring

scripts.kv:setup: npm run kv:create && npm run kv:bind
scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv:namespace create AGENT_STATE && wrangler kv:namespace create JOB_QUEUE && wrangler kv:namespace create REPO_CACHE && wrangler kv:namespace create RESOLUTION_LOG
scripts.queue:setup: wrangler queues create agent-tasks && wrangler queues create repo-sync && wrangler queues create self-resolution
scripts.r2:setup: wrangler r2 bucket create blackroad-repo-snapshots && wrangler r2 bucket create blackroad-agent-artifacts
scripts.setup: npm run kv:setup && npm run queue:setup && npm run r2:setup && npm run db:migrate

author: BlackRoad OS <blackroad.systems@gmail.com>
